we introduce a novel 3D representation learning method, Concentric Spherical Graph Neural Network (CSGNN) that learns representations of arbitrary oriented 3D inputs in an end-to-end manner, and demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned representations on a variety of 3D tasks.
we introduce an efficient and effective 3D GNN model that learns 3D representations for point clouds and meshes.
we propose a novel GNN architecture for 3D point clouds that learns a representation of the data that is invariant to rotations.
